text: Great to see high quality benchmarks with headroom and look at that cost line for Carbon — quoting @SemiAnalysis_: Today we’re releasing GDPx, a benchmark for measuring agentic capabilities across the most valuable domains. GDPx is a true frontier-level benchmark: even the best model scores just 12% (1/7)
zh: 皮查伊：很高兴看到高质量、仍有提升空间的基准测试，也看看 Carbon 那条成本曲线 — 引用 @SemiAnalysis_：今日发布 GDPx，衡量高价值领域代理能力的前沿基准，目前最好模型也只得 12%

text: President Trump has delivered historic wins for America's fishing industry by putting American fishermen FIRST, unlocking billions of dollars in economic growth, revitalizing the industry, & providing critical regulatory relief.
zh: 白宫：特朗普为美国渔业放松监管、优先保护本国渔民，释放数十亿美元经济增长。

text: The other supercompute projects are unable to reach their goals, but SpaceX is already achieving ours — quoting: SpaceXAI's Colossus 2 in Memphis is the world's most powerful AI data center, roughly 1.11 million H100 equivalents, ahead of OpenAI's Stargate.
zh: 马斯克：其他超算项目达不到目标，SpaceX 已经在实现我们的目标（引述：孟菲斯 Colossus 2 约合 111 万块 H100，是全球最强 AI 数据中心，领先 OpenAI 星际之门）。

text: Tesla and SpaceX have created meaningful wealth for hundreds of thousands of employees over time and improved the retirement savings of hundreds of millions of people
zh: 马斯克：特斯拉和 SpaceX 多年来为数十万员工创造了可观财富，也改善了数亿人的养老储蓄。
